name: Skin the Cat
instructions: Hang from the rings with straight arms and an overhand grip.
Tuck the knees to the chest and lift the hips until the legs pass between the arms.
Lower the feet behind you under control. Stop when the shoulders reach the end of their comfortable range.
Pull the hips back up and pass the legs between the arms again to return to the hang.

name: Hollow Rock
instructions: Lie on your back. Press the lower back into the floor.
Lift the shoulders and the straight legs a short distance off the floor, with the arms by the ears.
Rock forward and back along the curve of the spine. Keep the body in the same shape.

Push up to a plank. Walk the feet up the wall while the hands walk back toward the wall.
Stop when the chest is close to the wall and the body is in a handstand line.
Walk the hands forward and the feet down until the chest is on the floor again.

instructions: Hold a handle of the rope in each hand, with the elbows close to the sides.
Jump a little higher than for a single jump, with the legs almost straight.
Turn the wrists fast, so that the rope passes under the feet two times before you land.
Land on the balls of the feet and go directly into the next jump.

name: Tuck Up
instructions: Lie on your back with the legs straight and the arms overhead, just off the floor.
Sit up and pull the knees to the chest at the same time. Reach the hands past the shins.

Lift the arms and the legs together and put the ball between the ankles.
Lower the arms and the legs toward the floor. The legs now hold the ball.

Lean the chest forward. Bend the elbows and lower the body until the upper arms are parallel to the floor.
